test_ctc_criterion: test the CTC loss computation by composing a CTC graph with emissions and computing forward scores
test_asg_criterion: test the ASG loss computation by composing emissions with transitions and computing forward scores
test_asg_viterbi_path: test the Viterbi path decoding by composing emissions with transitions and extracting the best path labels
create_emissions_graph: create a linear emissions graph from a flat vector of probabilities or log probabilities
create_ctc_graph: create a CTC lattice graph from a target label sequence and a blank token index
